authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10452 yāti explicitly gives Hindi jānā, Maithili jāeb and Old Marwari jāvaï go; ordinary imperative jā-/jo forms fit this verb. The article separately derives suppletive g- past forms from gata, which are not included here. Exact survey form jɔ is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
